Name: Junimoji
Author: SpaceNeb
Description:
[size=5]Summary[/size]
After reaching level 5 in the mines, you complete the first Explore The Mines quest. The next day, you receive a message from The Wizard, detailing a mysterious energy coming from inside the farm cave. You find an arcade machine labeled “Junimoji”. Once you interact with the machine, you are teleported to a new world! As you explore the new jungle and monsters, meet characters such as Arock, a trapped adventurer, and Evil Warlock, who wants to summon the jungle temple to the real world. This mod is lighthearted, comical, and has an amulet which increases the player’s speed as a reward.

[size=5]Features[/size]
Jungle/Temple Location
The Jungle/Temple is a new world the player can explore by delving into to machine in the farm cave. Within the Jungle lies a temple where the player can play mini-games to get key fragments to stop the summoning ritual.

Junimoji Amulet
This amulet grants the player a permanent speed boost.

[size=5]Installation Guide[/size]
This mode is 1.6 compatible.

IGM provides an educational environment that supports and encourages creative and collaborative academic inquiry by both faculty and students. IGM’s programs,  coursework, research, and development efforts provide students with the knowledge and skills to pursue meaningful  and rewarding careers in media-centric, interactive software development, while simultaneously advancing the field and helping to provide a well-rounded educational experience.”
